name: equilibrator_feasibility_gate
description: Real eQuilibrator ΔG' feasibility gate over H2-driven reductive CO2 fixation (formate/acetate/pyruvate) at a fixed vent condition.

thermo.doc:
Real eQuilibrator feasibility gate over a configured reaction set.

For each reaction it emits ``dg_<name>`` (ΔG', kJ/mol) and
``feasible_<name>`` (a multiplier in [0, 1], ~1 when ΔG' is very negative
and ~0 when positive), plus ``free_energy_logged`` as a witness that the
thermodynamics were evaluated this tick. A ``Step`` (stateless per tick):
it reads the conditions and reports sensor values. ΔG'° is cached per
rounded ``(pH, I, T)`` so only ΔG''s ln(Q) term is recomputed each tick.

The reaction set defaults to :data:`VENT_CARBON_FIXATION` (H2-driven
reductive CO2 fixation to formate/acetate/pyruvate); pass ``reactions`` in
config to gate a different network. Input/output ports are derived from the
reaction set, so the default config reproduces the ports
``{pH, ionic_strength, temperature, CO2, H2, formate, acetate, pyruvate}``
→ ``{dg_*, feasible_*, free_energy_logged}``.

_contract.summary: Real eQuilibrator feasibility gate: (pH, I, T, substrates, products) -> dG' + feasibility per reaction.
_contract.description: A stateless Step bridging the real equilibrator_api component-contribution engine (offline cache). Each tick it reads the fluid conditions and the live concentrations of the configured reaction set and emits the transformed Gibbs energy dG' = dG'0(pH, I, T) + RT ln Q plus a logistic feasibility multiplier in [0,1] that downstream kinetics can use as a thermodynamic gate. dG'0 is cached and recomputed only when pH / ionic strength / temperature change.
assumptions: Physiological (transformed) dG' at the given pH / I / T.

emitter.doc:
Store historical states in memory.

``subsample`` records only every Nth composite tick (default 1 =
every tick). Use this for long runs or composites with heavy
state (large fields, many agents) to keep RAM bounded — the
saved time-series still reflects the simulation's true cadence
via each row's ``global_time`` field.

``max_len`` optionally bounds ``history`` to the most recent N
recorded rows (a ring buffer): once the cap is reached each new
record drops the oldest. Default ``None`` = unbounded (the
historical behaviour — consumers such as v2ecoli that read the
full ``history`` are unaffected unless they opt in). ``max_len``
counts *recorded* rows (i.e. post-``subsample``).
